criteria.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/gh/client.rs exists and holds the Host API client row (Checks, NewPr, PrDraft, PrHost, CiRunState, MergeMethod, MergeMethods, GhClient with its Host, PrHost and CiSource impls, the CommitHost impl, parse_ci_runs, parse_check_run, parse_ci_run, parse_merged_pr, parse_remote, classify_checks, failing_test_name); `git diff` shows these definitions removed from gh/mod.rs with the same text and no body edits.
criteria.evidence: client.rs (678 lines) defines every listed item: Checks at line 19, NewPr 30, PrDraft 41, PrHost 49, CiRunState 80, MergeMethod 179, MergeMethods 202, GhClient 241, then the Host, PrHost, CiSource and CommitHost impls, and all the parse_*, classify_checks and failing_test_name functions. The mod.rs diff shows all of them deleted. Diffing base mod.rs against client.rs gives 11 insertions and 3809 deletions, so client.rs is the base text in its original order plus 11 lines. Those 11 are 2 doc lines, 6 `use` lines and 3 `pub(super)` lines. No body line differs.

criteria.criterion: Public paths are unchanged: gh/mod.rs has `mod client;` and re-exports every previously public moved name, so a Grep of crates/ and xtask/ for `gh::(GhClient|PrHost|Checks|CiRunState|MergeMethod|parse_)` finds the same paths as before and each resolves; no caller outside gh/ has an edited import.
criteria.evidence: mod.rs adds `mod client;` and `pub use client::{CI_WORKFLOW, Checks, CiRunState, GhClient, MergeMethod, MergeMethods, NewPr, PrDraft, PrHost, classify_checks, failing_test_name, parse_check_run, parse_ci_run, parse_ci_runs, parse_merged_pr, parse_remote};`, which covers every moved public name. A Grep for gh:: paths to these names finds them in crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs, crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs and crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs. The diff stat shows none of those files changed. They still resolve, because Athena's clippy and test runs on this tree passed.

My Grep found callers outside gh/ in 3 files (main.rs, display.rs, run_pin_tests.rs); none is edited. summary: The candidate passes. It moves the Host API client row out of gh/mod.rs into a new gh/client.rs without changing the moved text. Comparing the two files directly (`git diff --stat` of base gh/mod.rs against the new gh/client.rs) finds only 11 lines in client.rs that were not in the base file: the 2-line module doc comment, 6 `use` lines, and 3 visibility changes to `pub(super)` (`api`, `repo_path` and `TEST_NAME_LIMIT`). Each of those 3 items is used by pages.rs or the mod.rs tests. gh/mod.rs declares `mod client;` and re-exports every moved public name, so public paths stay the same. The diff touches only gh/mod.rs, gh/client.rs and CHANGELOG.md, so no caller outside gh/ is edited. Callers in main.rs, display.rs and run_pin_tests.rs still compile, as Athena's clippy and test records show. The only test edits are 4 added `use` lines in mod.rs's test module. No `#[test]` is added or removed, so the test list is unchanged, and the three tests named in section 5.1 of the design doc still exist and pass. I ran `cargo test --locked -p athena-core --lib gh::tests`: 73 of 73 passed. Two problems are minor and do not affect the verdict. The CHANGELOG entry is slightly inaccurate: it says only `api` and `repo_path` become `pub(super)` and that gh/mod.rs calls them, but `TEST_NAME_LIMIT` was also widened and only pages.rs calls those methods. The entry also leaves out the moved private constant `CI_CHECK_STEP`.
